pattern: の中で[A]が一番（のなかで[A]がいちばん）
purpose: Identify the most preferred or extreme item in a group.
keywords: Group + の中で + item + が一番 + description.
Of all fruit, I like peaches best.
My father is the tallest in our family.
Of the three plans, this one is the simplest.
formation: Group + の中で + item + が一番 + description.
restrictions: Name the comparison group clearly when the context does not supply it.
mistake: The group and the selected member serve different roles.
